A session to render: the unified `SessionUIMessage[]` (preferred — what `GET /api/captain/sessions/{id}` serves), a legacy `SessionEntry[]` log, or raw log text (JSON array or JSONL).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/SessionViewer.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { SessionInput } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```
